Health Connect Export reads data from Health Connect only for the categories you select and grant: steps, sleep, heart rate, weight, distance, and active calories. It requests read access only and never writes to Health Connect.

What it reads: daily totals or averages computed by the Health Connect aggregate API for each local day (sleep for the night ending each day, 18:00 to 18:00). It never sends individual samples, sleep stages, or source apps.

When it reads: when you tap Sync now or Create export, and, only if you turn on Automatic sync and allow background access, periodically in the background. Android schedules background runs at most about every 15 minutes and often later.

Where the data goes: sync sends the last 30 days of daily values over HTTPS directly to the one private site this app is paired with (built into the app, or the site whose address you confirmed when pairing), and nowhere else. To pair, you paste a one-time connection code from your site; the app keeps the resulting credentials encrypted with an Android Keystore key. When you open the app or tap Check status, it also asks your site whether this phone is still connected, when it last synced, and whether ChatGPT access is on; that request sends no health data. The app has no analytics or advertising, does not log health values, and is excluded from Android backup and device transfer. Optional export files stay in the app's private storage until you choose Share or Save to Files.

Why: so your own private ChatGPT plugin can read the daily summaries when you allow it on your site. This is separate from ChatGPT Health and does not connect to it. Pairing does not turn on ChatGPT access.

Your controls: turn off Automatic sync, disconnect (revokes and erases the credentials), revoke any category or background access in Health Connect, delete exports in this app, and delete data or turn off ChatGPT access on your site.

This app is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice.
